description: Layer-1 catalog of ClawQL MCP tools, Cursor skills, and known anti-patterns for Fast Decision enrichment. Classifier sees whenToUse / whenNotToUse / ontologyRole — not bare candidate ids or query-lexical shell bait.

capabilities.label: search
capabilities.whenToUse: Discover provider/API operationIds from natural language before execute
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a substitute for firm-knowledge SQL cohort counts or ontology flag recall

capabilities.label: execute
capabilities.whenToUse: Run a known operationId with validated arguments after search
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Do not guess operationIds; search first

capabilities.label: memory_recall
capabilities.whenToUse: Retrieve vault/ontology context; enumerate matters by schema filters and title flags (HSR_SECOND_REQUEST, CREDIT_FACILITY)
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Do not use blind bash/grep over DMS when ontology flags or SQL cohorts exist; avoid over-broad practiceArea-only filters when a precise flag exists

capabilities.label: memory_ingest
capabilities.whenToUse: Persist durable decisions, insights, and session outcomes to the vault
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for querying firm-knowledge cohorts

capabilities.label: structured corpus / data_query / clawql_sql
capabilities.whenToUse: Exact cohort counts and schema filters over pre-ingested DuckDB/matters (is_credit_facility, mentions_springing_lien, HSR flags). Prefer when denominator N must be correct.
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Do not replace with bash ls/grep hunts when the structured corpus is available

capabilities.label: cache
capabilities.whenToUse: Ephemeral session scratch state during multi-step workflows
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not durable vault storage; not firm-knowledge search

capabilities.label: audit
capabilities.whenToUse: Append/list WORM-linked audit events for consequential actions
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a document search tool

capabilities.label: skills_list
capabilities.whenToUse: Cheap discovery of SkillIndexEntry (name, description, digest)
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Fetch full skill body with skills_get only after selection

capabilities.label: skills_get
capabilities.whenToUse: Load full SkillContent for a selected skill id
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Do not load every skill body during ranking

capabilities.label: sandbox_exec
capabilities.whenToUse: Isolated code snippets with safe persistence when Agent Substrate is required
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for firm-knowledge cohort enumeration

capabilities.label: notify
capabilities.whenToUse: Send actionable Slack milestones and failure notifications
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for firm-knowledge search or cohort counts

capabilities.label: schedule
capabilities.whenToUse: Recurring synthetic checks with dry_run validation
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for one-shot firm-knowledge queries

capabilities.label: ingest_external_knowledge
capabilities.whenToUse: Import external markdown or URL content with dry-run-first validation
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for querying already-ingested firm corpus

capabilities.label: knowledge_search_onyx
capabilities.whenToUse: Ground workflows in enterprise Onyx evidence before execution
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a substitute for structured DuckDB cohort SQL when flags exist

capabilities.label: clawql_think
capabilities.whenToUse: Structured chain-of-thought before consequential decisions
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a data retrieval tool

capabilities.label: pageindex_*
capabilities.whenToUse: Build/traverse/synthesize document trees for long-form evidence
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for exact SQL cohort counts

capabilities.label: ouroboros_*
capabilities.whenToUse: Specification-first evolutionary loops with lineage and drift checks
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a substitute for kubectl/Helm or firm-knowledge SQL

capabilities.label: unstructured shell/grep hunt
capabilities.whenToUse: Only when no structured corpus or ontology flags exist for the task
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Never first tool for pre-ingested firm-knowledge cohorts with schema flags or SQL denominators — prefer memory_recall or structured SQL; unstructured shell has no cohort N

capabilities.label: Harvey credit-facility SQL cohort
capabilities.whenToUse: Committed procedure for Banking & Finance springing-lien rate via structured corpus
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Invalid if skill validity rolled back

capabilities.label: Harvey HSR second-request recall
capabilities.whenToUse: Committed procedure to list antitrust matters with HSR_SECOND_REQUEST via ontology recall
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Do not confuse with HSR filing-only prompts

capabilities.label: clawql-search-workflows
capabilities.whenToUse: Discover correct operationIds before execute, especially multi-provider
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for firm-knowledge cohort SQL

capabilities.label: clawql-execute-workflows
capabilities.whenToUse: Execute discovered API operations with validation and post-change verification
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Search first when operationId unknown

capabilities.label: clawql-memory-recall
capabilities.whenToUse: Recall vault context before deep work with focused queries and graph depth
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a substitute for DuckDB cohort SQL when schema flags exist

capabilities.label: clawql-memory-ingest
capabilities.whenToUse: Persist durable outcomes with stable titles, append threading, wikilinks
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for querying cohorts

capabilities.label: clawql-vault-memory
capabilities.whenToUse: Deep Obsidian vault ingest/recall with structured insights and session threading
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not for unstructured DMS greps when ontology exists

capabilities.label: clawql-cache-workflows
capabilities.whenToUse: Ephemeral scratch state during active sessions via cache MCP tool
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not durable vault storage

capabilities.label: clawql-audit-workflows
capabilities.whenToUse: Append/list/clear audit patterns during multi-step runs
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a search tool

capabilities.label: clawql-notify-workflows
capabilities.whenToUse: Actionable Slack milestones and failure notifications
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not firm-knowledge retrieval

capabilities.label: clawql-schedule-workflows
capabilities.whenToUse: Recurring synthetic checks with dry_run, often paired with notify
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not one-shot cohort queries

capabilities.label: clawql-sandbox-exec
capabilities.whenToUse: Isolated code snippets via sandbox_exec with safe persistence
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not firm-knowledge cohort enumeration

capabilities.label: clawql-composed-mcp-workflows
capabilities.whenToUse: End-to-end recipes combining search/execute, memory, notify, schedule
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Prefer narrower skills when a single tool path is clear

capabilities.label: clawql-onyx-knowledge-workflows
capabilities.whenToUse: Ground workflows in enterprise Onyx evidence before execution
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not DuckDB cohort SQL

capabilities.label: clawql-ouroboros-workflows
capabilities.whenToUse: Spec-first evolutionary loops with lineage; not raw kubectl/Helm
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not firm-knowledge SQL

capabilities.label: clawql-external-ingest
capabilities.whenToUse: Import external markdown/URL via ingest_external_knowledge with dry-run-first
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not querying already-ingested corpus

capabilities.label: deep-thinking
capabilities.whenToUse: Chain-of-thought before consequential decisions, restarts, or postmortems
capabilities.whenNotToUse: Not a data retrieval path
